hero.headline: Sector
hero.description: From telecom towers to smart energy — Invendis delivers purpose-built IIoT solutions across multiple industrial verticals with proven global deployments.

sectors.title: Telecom Tower Infrastructure
sectors.desc: Invendis's flagship vertical with 150,000+ sites deployed across Africa, the Middle East, and South & Southeast Asia. Our end-to-end telecom OA solution covers passive infrastructure monitoring, energy management, battery optimisation, and predictive maintenance.
sectors.clients: · Telecel · Jio · Airtel · Econet · American Tower Corporation (ATC) · Irrawaddy Green Towers  (IGT) · ISON · Altius · Tower of Africa · Tawal · Indus Africa

sectors.title: Solar & Renewable Energy
sectors.desc: Comprehensive solar monitoring with real-time data on generation, consumption, and anomaly detection. Launched in 2016 with ongoing deployments for telecom and utility clients.

sectors.title: Smart Energy & Utilities
sectors.desc: Smart metering, tariff-grade energy measurement, and utility billing platforms for distribution companies and industrial consumers.

sectors.title: Edge Compute & Industrial Networks
sectors.desc: Industrial networking solutions for edge computation, protocol bridging, and secure connectivity — including 4G/5G routers, SD-WAN, and Modbus/DNP3 converters.

sectors.title: ESG & Sustainability for Solar Applications
sectors.desc: Enabling customers to meet ESG targets through real-time energy monitoring, carbon tracking, and automated sustainability reporting across large site portfolios for solar applications
